Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 2692/2020

Dear Mr. Bhosale,

Thank you for meeting us on 4 August 2020 about your dispute with M/s Kulkarni Technologies Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry.

Our advice is to demand the domestic enquiry report and challenge it for breach of natural justice. Please collect the charge sheet, the enquiry report and the reply to the charge sheet and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
